svg.title: G1 Concept: integrated process map
svg.desc: Process map of phase G1 Concept: CON-01 Define the robot and its limits (Joint, after nothing); CON-02 Specify the operating envelopes and tasks (Risk assessment, after CON-01); CON-03 Analyse human-robot interaction, contact limits and foreseeable misuse (Risk assessment, after CON-02); CON-04 Hazard identification and risk assessment (Risk assessment, after CON-03); CON-05 Specify the safety functions and their required PL (Safety-related control, after CON-04); CON-06 Analyse functional insufficiencies of perception and the locomotion policy (Risk assessment, after CON-04); CON-07 Risk reduction concept (Risk assessment, after CON-05, CON-06); CON-08 Cybersecurity threat and risk assessment (Cybersecurity, after CON-04); CON-09 Cybersecurity requirements and security level target (Cybersecurity, after CON-05, CON-08); CON-10 Define the ML components and their safety requirements (Machine learning, after CON-05, CON-06); CON-11 Test operations hold point (Joint, after CON-04); CON-12 Record the hazard log and the argument structure (Joint, after CON-07, CON-09, CON-10).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P1 Concept: who does what, in what order
